question: What does Professor Mohamed Abouelenien research?
ground_truth: Professor Mohamed Abouelenien researches artificial intelligence, cognitive load sensing, and adaptive scaffolding to support collaborative simulation-based learning in high-stakes environments. He is the director of the Artificial Intelligence Research Lab (AIR) at UM-Dearborn.
